description: This PHP source file is part of an OpenCart extension module, specifically a controller class for managing marketplace extensions within the admin interface. It provides methods for listing, installing, and uninstalling marketplace extensions, handling user permissions, loading dependencies, and rendering views.

classes.name: Marketplace
classes.description: Controller class for managing marketplace extensions, including listing available extensions, and handling installation and uninstallation processes within the admin area.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes the extension list view and outputs the list.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and prepares the list of marketplace extensions, their statuses, and generates data for the view.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles the process of installing a marketplace extension, including permission checks, loading dependencies, and calling the installation routine.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Handles the process of uninstalling a marketplace extension, including permission checks and calling the uninstall routine.
